title: Freeze Phase 1 compatibility with regression fences
what_to_build: Add and expand regression coverage that pins the current external behavior Phase 1 must preserve. Cover sync and stream config parity, thread and create-thread parity, AgentActor JSON-string behavior, class-level agentic_stream behavior, and stream ordering / first-token behavior so later refactor slices can proceed safely.
acceptance_criteria: Regression tests explicitly cover sync and stream config cascade parity for current public entrypoints.
Regression tests explicitly cover thread and create-thread behavior for sync and stream execution paths.
Regression tests explicitly cover AgentActor.agentic() JSON-string output, class-level agentic_stream behavior, and stream ordering / first-token behavior.

title: Introduce ResolvedAgentCall and unify mixin call normalization
blocked_by: Freeze Phase 1 compatibility with regression fences
what_to_build: Create a shared resolved call object for AgentMixin entrypoints and route both agentic() and agentic_stream() through one call-normalization path. Normalize prompt, tools, constraints, user, thread, create-thread, and result-type behavior without changing externally visible semantics.
acceptance_criteria: AgentMixin.agentic() and AgentMixin.agentic_stream() share one call-normalization path via ResolvedAgentCall.
Prompt, tools, constraints, user, thread, create-thread, and result-type behavior remain externally unchanged.
Existing and newly added regression tests pass without adapter-visible behavior changes.

title: Introduce Agent runtime preparation for sync execution
blocked_by: Freeze Phase 1 compatibility with regression fences
Introduce ResolvedAgentCall and unify mixin call normalization
what_to_build: Add the internal Agent runtime seam for sync execution. Move llm override handling, llm resolution, root lookup, thread preload/create behavior, tool wrapping, deps creation, usage limits, and runnable agent construction behind Agent.prepare(...), then route AgentMixin.agentic() through Agent.prepare(...) and Agent.run(...).
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated internal Agent abstraction owns sync runtime preparation and sync execution entry from the mixin path.
Sync execution no longer rebuilds runtime setup ad hoc inside AgentMixin.
All sync behavior remains compatible with existing regression tests, including thread and result behavior.

title: Move streaming execution behind the shared Agent runtime
blocked_by: Freeze Phase 1 compatibility with regression fences
Introduce ResolvedAgentCall and unify mixin call normalization
Introduce Agent runtime preparation for sync execution
what_to_build: Route AgentMixin.agentic_stream() through the same resolved-call and runtime-preparation seam, and move streaming execution behind Agent.run_stream(...). Preserve stream chunk names, payload shapes, ordering, done/error behavior, and first-token behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Streaming entrypoints use the same resolved-call and Agent.prepare(...) path as sync entrypoints.
Agent.run_stream(...) owns terminal streaming execution while preserving existing chunk shapes and ordering.
Stream regression tests pass unchanged, including first-token and class-level streaming coverage.

title: Rewire AgentActor onto the explicit Agent runtime seam
blocked_by: Freeze Phase 1 compatibility with regression fences
Introduce ResolvedAgentCall and unify mixin call normalization
Introduce Agent runtime preparation for sync execution
Move streaming execution behind the shared Agent runtime
what_to_build: Replace AgentActor’s descriptor-internal reach-in with a thin DB-backed adapter path that resolves into the same Agent runtime seam used by AgentMixin. Preserve AgentActor JSON-string output for sync calls, current stream behavior, and current config merge semantics.
acceptance_criteria: AgentActor no longer calls AgentMixin descriptor internals to reach execution behavior.
AgentActor uses a thin adapter helper to resolve DB-backed configuration into the shared runtime path.
AgentActor sync and stream regression tests pass with preserved JSON-string sync output and preserved config merge semantics.

title: Normalize sync result shape internally while preserving external contracts
blocked_by: Rewire AgentActor onto the explicit Agent runtime seam
what_to_build: Establish one internal Python result shape for successful sync execution. Have AgentMixin.agentic() return that Python result directly, and have AgentActor.agentic() serialize the same result to JSON for compatibility so result handling no longer duplicates execution logic.
acceptance_criteria: Agent.run(...) produces one internal Python sync-result shape used by both adapters.
AgentMixin.agentic() returns the Python result shape without changing externally expected behavior.
AgentActor.agentic() serializes the same internal result to JSON and preserves compatibility for existing callers.
